input: Azure Machine Learning batch endpoints run asynchronous jobs over data assets.
The embedding requests consume quota from the referenced Foundry deployment.
A dedicated deployment isolates batch throughput from interactive traffic.
Packing multiple texts into one embedding request reduces requests per minute.
Token usage remains approximately the same when the same texts are embedded.
Input identifiers preserve correlation after compatible requests are packed.
OpenAI response indexes map each embedding to its position in the packed array.
The AML parent job name identifies the complete asynchronous batch run.
Managed identity authenticates the compute job to the Foundry endpoint.
Trace output records packing mode, online request count, and input count.
Requests with different dimensions or encoding formats are never combined.
A configurable input cap limits the failure scope of each online request.
